description: Edit a post's working content, title, buttons or attention flag. Pass expectedRevision from get_post or the last mutation. On revision_conflict, reread and compare changes; reapply only intended edits with the current revision. Never bypass revision checks. Scheduled and sent messages keep their snapshots until apply_post_to_publication is requested.

expectedRevision.description: Current revision from get_post/last mutation. On conflict reread and compare changes; never bypass revision.

inlineButtons.description: Separate Telegram keyboard, normally rows: [[{"text":"Open","url":"https://example.com"}]]. A legacy flat array is also supported. RichDocument button blocks use a different type/value shape.

copyText.description: Text to copy when the button is pressed.

text.description: Text to copy to the clipboard.

iconCustomEmojiId.description: Telegram custom emoji id for the button icon, when supported.

botUsername.description: Username of the bot linked to the login action.

forwardText.description: Button text shown when this login button is forwarded.

requestWriteAccess.description: Whether to request permission for the bot to message the user.

style.description: Optional button color: primary, success or danger.

switchInlineQuery.description: Inline query inserted after choosing a chat.

switchInlineQueryChosenChat.description: Inline query with permitted chat types for the Telegram chooser.

query.description: Inline query text to prefill in the selected permitted chat.

switchInlineQueryCurrentChat.description: Inline query inserted in the current chat.

type.description: Telegram keyboard action type; choose exactly one supported action.

url.description: URL action, e.g. https://example.com. Canonical external keyboard field is url, not RichDocument value.

value.description: Compatibility alias for url only when type=url. Prefer url.

webApp.description: Telegram Web App action with its HTTPS URL.
